data.title: Dismissal from Weingut Musterreben KG, effective 31 January 2027
data.summary: Weingut Musterreben KG terminates Ute Beispielberger's employment (Arbeitsvertrag AV-2020-07) for operational reasons, effective 31 January 2027, because the bottle sales position is being discontinued. The letter notes a possible lawsuit against the dismissal must be filed at the labor court within three weeks of receipt.
data.explanation: Your employer has given notice ending your job on 31 January 2027 because the sales department is closing. If you think the dismissal is unfair, you may file a lawsuit (Kündigungsschutzklage) with the labor court — the app will show the deadline for this. You must also register as job-seeking (arbeitsuchend) with the Agentur für Arbeit immediately to avoid cuts to unemployment benefit; this is not tied to a fixed calendar date but should be done right away. Consider consulting a lawyer or your works council if you want to challenge the dismissal.
